newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Woodies earn crack at eighth grand slam title.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Woodies earn crack at eighth grand slam title.

text.p: Australia's most successful doubles partnership, Mark Woodforde and Todd Woodbridge, on Friday earned a chance to grab their eighth grand slam doubles title when they won their semifinal at the Australian Open.
The top-seeded "Woodies" beat American pair Rick Leach and Jonathan Stark in four sets, 6-3 7-6 (7-2) 5-7 6-1.
The Australians, who communicate so well on the court they barely need to speak to each other, were more dominant than the scoreline suggested but converted only a third of 15 break points.
The Woodies are on a roll after a sensational year in 1996, when they won the Olympics and lifted their fourth straight Wimbledon doubles title, the first pair to do so this century.
They now meet seventh seeded Sebastien Lareau of Canada and Alex O'Brien of the United States in the final on Saturday.
Lareau and O'Brien won their semifinal in five sets, 4-6 6-2 6-4 5-7 6-2, against third-seeded Dutch partnerhsip Jacco Eltingh and Paul Haarhuis.
